name: Audio Wavesurfer Clip
description: Adds a widget/UI to define audio clip regions on a wavesurfer waveform, backed by the Audio Clips API.
project_description: Audio Wavesurfer Clip is a sub-module of Audio Wavesurfer. It provides a field widget (Audio Wavesurfer Clip Widget) and a form element that overlay draggable clip regions on the wavesurfer waveform, letting editors define start/end times for one or more clip types on an audio media item. Clip persistence, clip-type definitions (min/max duration) and the actual FFmpeg-based audio cutting are provided by the required Audio Clips API module (audio_clips); this sub-module wires that API to the wavesurfer UI. On audio media save it (re)creates or updates the corresponding audio_clip entities via the Audio Clips service, and optionally regenerates stored waveforms for the clipped files. A companion Audio Wavesurfer Clip Formatter can display a specific clip type instead of the original audio. Compatible formats: MP3, WAV.
